issues.description: The source subtitle is a single line with clear separation below the title, but the rendered subtitle is too narrow and too close to the title, forcing the final two characters onto a second line and materially disrupting the title/subtitle hierarchy.

background_seams.rationale: The pale background and corner decorations remain continuous, with no hard rectangular seams or mismatched local surface colors.

connector_endpoints.rationale: The source contains no arrowheads or connector endpoints requiring attachment or direction review.

connector_topology.rationale: The source is a six-card capability grid and contains no semantic process connectors; the short horizontal rules are internal card dividers.

crop_boundaries.rationale: All six preserved icon assets remain cleanly contained within their rounded tiles, without opaque rectangular leakage, halos, clipping, or mismatched crop surfaces.

key_proportions.rationale: The six card dimensions, two-row grid spacing, icon tiles, text columns, and decorative corner ellipses retain the source proportions and balance.

typography_hierarchy.rationale: The rendered subtitle wraps its final two characters to a second line and crowds the title instead of preserving the source's clean single-line hierarchy.

visual_depth.rationale: The source's flat card treatment, subtle border hierarchy, icon-tile contrast, and translucent decorative layers are preserved without visible depth loss.
